datasets.title: HDX HAPI Data for Ecuador
datasets.description: This dataset contains data obtained from the HDX Humanitarian API (HDX HAPI), which provides standardized humanitarian indicators designed for seamless interoperability from multiple sources. The data facilitates automated workflows and visualizations to support humanitarian decision making. For more information, please see the HDX HAPI landing page and documentation .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hdx-hapi-ecu]
datasets.details: HDX HAPI is refreshed daily, but the source datasets may have different update schedules. Please refer to the source datasets for each subcategory to verify their specific update frequency.

entity.name: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED)

lineage.description: HDX HAPI aggregates standardized humanitarian indicators from nine contributing organizations including ACLED, IPC, IOM, UNHCR, and WFP. Data is collected through national assessments, administrative registries, and event monitoring systems, then harmonized into common administrative geographies and temporal periods. The dataset integrates conflict events, displacement records, food security classifications, and baseline population to support humanitarian decision-making in Ecuador.
